target: new: colour or translucency of the marks (punctate PATO_0001512, marks purple PATO_0000951)
reason: The word means dotted (PATO_0001512 punctate) with the dots purple. The colour belongs to the dots, not to the petal, so it can't be written as two separate qualities of the petal. If the pattern isn't built, it falls back to punctate.

Sooty (Latin fuliginosus) is the dull brownish black of soot. 'Cortice fuliginoso obtecti' (bark covered with a sooty layer) may describe a sooty-mould coating, so this rule should be reviewed for bark.
Wire-like and the Spanish alambrino mean slender, tough and resilient like wire. That is the definition of FLOPO:0991214 wiry.
Withering but staying attached is the definition of FLOPO:0991181 marcescent.
Geminate is a synonym of FLOPO:0991004 paired, so 'not geminate' is its negation. The bearer, sympodial unit, has no PO class, so the statement still needs a bearer rule.
The prefix sub- means 'nearly', applied to ascending. Pattern 01 handles it the same way as suborbicular.

label: tectate
definition: A structural quality inhering in a pollen grain wall by virtue of the outer layer of its exine forming a continuous or perforate roof (tectum) supported by columellae.
reason: A standard palynological wall type, with intectate and semitectate as siblings. Presence of the tectum can't be used instead, because PO has no exine or tectum class. FLOPO already has pollen values such as trisyncolpate.
Trinerve means three-nerved: a count of veins, the same as '5-nerved'. It is not triplinerved (FLOPO:0991202), where the lateral veins leave the midvein above the base.
The ventral appendage is the connective appendage, so it is a part. Its length is an ordinary measurement: length (PATO_0000122) under pattern 02.

'Tardily caducous' means eventually falling, but late. That is plainly deciduous, with 'tardily' kept as a qualifier in the record. It must not go to fugacious (FLOPO:0991231), which means falling early.
This is a length (PATO_0000122) of anther canals (tubules), and neither PO nor FLOPO has a class for those. The fix is a new anatomy class, not a quality term.
This describes how the set of stamens is arranged (the androecium is symmetrical), not a quality of one stamen. The second example is a cut-off fragment.

target: new: colour or translucency of the marks (striated PATO_0001410, marks translucent PATO_0001354)
reason: It means marked with translucent lines (oil cavities). The translucency belongs to the lines, not to the leaf. This is the same pattern as purple-punctate, and it falls back to striated.
Attached to (PATO_0001667) needs the thing it is attached to (the substrate, the seed body), and 'loosely' is only a degree. The previous review rejected 'contiguous' for the same reason.
These are moss lamina cells that are rhomboid with the long axis set obliquely. The shape is PATO_0001938, and 'obliquely' stays in the record as an orientation word.
'Abruptly short-pointed at the tip' is an apex ending abruptly in a short point, which is the definition of FLOPO:0991054 mucronate.
The phyllary margins carry fine cobwebby hairs. PATO_0002344 arachnose (fine, entangled cobweb-like hairs) applies with the margin as the bearer.

target: new: compound of two values that both hold (white PATO_0000323 approximate; opaque PATO_0000963)
reason: The latex is both whitish (approximately white) and cloudy (opaque). Both hold, so this is not a continuum between the two words, which is how the playbook reads a hyphenated compound.

label: lemon-scented
definition: An odorous quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its having a fresh, sharp odour like that of lemon peel.
reason: A recognised flower and leaf scent, alongside the existing classes FLOPO:0991016 sweet-scented and FLOPO:0991017 spicy-scented. No existing odour value covers it.
It negates FLOPO:0991082 accrescent: the perianth does not enlarge after flowering.
'Cordate-clasping' is an amplexicaul base with cordate lobes. Its negation is closest to 'not amplexicaul', although the base could in principle clasp without being cordate.
It negates PATO_0002407 indurated (firm or hard).
Lepidote means covered with small scales, which is PATO_0001804 scaly, the parent of the FLOPO scale values. 'Not lepidote' is its negation.
It negates PATO_0005010 plumose, as applied to beaks and awns.
It gives where along the length the part is widest, a measure that defines shapes such as ovate (pattern 17). It is not a shape term by itself.
A relation with its second part named: adnate (FLOPO:0991129) towards the costa. The bearer 'segment' still needs the organ it belongs to.

target: new: compound of two values that both hold (angular PATO_0001977; elongated PATO_0001154)
reason: The rostellum is both angular and elongated. These are two shape values that hold together, not one term and not a continuum.
Fine, soft hairs lying flat are silky, which is PATO_0104358 sericeous. Villous (FLOPO:0991051) implies spreading, shaggy hair, so it does not fit.

target: new: compound of two values that both hold (conical PATO_0002021; flattened PATO_0002254)
reason: The tubercles and beaks are cone-shaped and also flattened. Both values hold, so this is the same conjunction pattern as cloudy-whitish.
